dynamic_rules.providers_list_reports.r01.d01: office_scope: the radio value office_scope.mode = office_group switches the picker to lookup:office_groups and the selection fills office_group_id (one group) or office_group_ids (several, enhancement); mode office fills office_ids (default working_office). A group resolves to its member offices intersected with the caller's readable offices. When the tenant has no office groups (every migrated tenant: office_groups is empty) the group mode offers the single value all, which resolves to every office the caller may read - the legacy 'group run covers all offices'. Same behaviour on lists.provider_holidays, lists.provider_operatory and lists.provider_registration (the rule is recorded once, on r01).

providers_list_reports.r01.s02.c02.notes: 108 = id of the office the user was working in (legacy correction: the box defaults to the session office, SELECT picks others). Offices (mode office) or office groups (mode office_group); the selection becomes exactly one of office_ids / office_group_id / office_group_ids; tokens working_office, my_offices; all = every office (or group) the caller may read. On this report the office is the provider's roster, not a transaction office: office_attribution = served_office (NEW value, owned by 03 5.1) = overlap of rpt_provider_dim.served_office_ids (provider_offices union home office) with the resolved office set; a provider serving two selected offices is listed under each office band. Which assignment the legacy filter reads (Works At offices assumed) is INFERRED - confirm on the live tool.

providers_list_reports.r02.s02.c02.notes: 108 = id of the office the user was working in (legacy correction: the box defaults to the session office, SELECT picks others). Offices (mode office) or office groups (mode office_group); the selection becomes exactly one of office_ids / office_group_id / office_group_ids; tokens working_office, my_offices; all = every office (or group) the caller may read. provider_holidays has no office column: the office set selects the providers through rpt_provider_dim.served_office_ids (office_attribution = served_office, NEW, 03 5.1); each holiday row is printed under every selected office the provider serves. INFERRED - confirm on the live tool whether legacy provider holidays are per office.

providers_list_reports.r03.s02.c02.notes: 108 = id of the office the user was working in (legacy correction: the box defaults to the session office, SELECT picks others). Offices (mode office) or office groups (mode office_group); the selection becomes exactly one of office_ids / office_group_id / office_group_ids; tokens working_office, my_offices; all = every office (or group) the caller may read. On this report the office is the office of the operatory (operatories.office_id; office_attribution = operatory_office, NEW, 03 5.1), not the provider's roster: an operatory assignment is listed only when its operatory belongs to a selected office.

providers_list_reports.r04.s02.c02.notes: 108 = id of the office the user was working in (legacy correction: the box defaults to the session office, SELECT picks others). Offices (mode office) or office groups (mode office_group); the selection becomes exactly one of office_ids / office_group_id / office_group_ids; tokens working_office, my_offices; all = every office (or group) the caller may read. Office of the provider roster (office_attribution = served_office, NEW, 03 5.1) via rpt_provider_dim.served_office_ids; this report has no provider picker, so the office set is the only population filter. INFERRED (low) - the whole report content must be confirmed on the live tool.

providers_list_reports.r01.s03.c01.notes: Legacy SELECT dialog (dual list with INCLUDE ALL, search, sort) becomes a searchable multi-select; ALL = no restriction; dialog content never captured - confirm list source and whether inactive providers are listed. Role on this report: the listed provider itself (provider_attribution = listed_provider, NEW value for 03 5.2): rpt_provider_dim.provider_id IN (:provider_ids). Not the treating, appointment or preferred provider. The option source lists the roster of the selected offices first, never excludes others (prefer-never-exclude); a picked provider outside the office set returns no row because the office filter still applies.

providers_list_reports.r02.s03.c01.notes: Legacy SELECT dialog (dual list with INCLUDE ALL, search, sort) becomes a searchable multi-select; ALL = no restriction; dialog content never captured - confirm list source and whether inactive providers are listed. Role: the provider who owns the holiday row (provider_holidays.provider_id; provider_attribution = listed_provider, NEW, 03 5.2).

providers_list_reports.r03.s03.c01.notes: Legacy SELECT dialog (dual list with INCLUDE ALL, search, sort) becomes a searchable multi-select; ALL = no restriction; dialog content never captured - confirm list source and whether inactive providers are listed. Role: the provider assigned to the operatory - operatories.provider_id (column default provider) or providers.default_operatory_id (provider_attribution = operatory_provider, NEW, 03 5.2). Legacy reads the Provider Setup > Ops tab; which of the two DentC links equals it is INFERRED.

providers_list_reports.r01.s04.c01.notes: Lookup-fed dropdown captured collapsed (only ALL known; value list never captured). Options from lookup:specialties (GET /provider-specialties). Filters rpt_provider_dim.specialty, free text, blank on 96 of 97 migrated providers: matched to the catalog value case-insensitively through rpt_value_map domain specialty (NEW, 03 3.7). ALL adds no predicate and keeps providers with a blank specialty; a selected value drops them (null_policy drop). Legacy is single-select; a list is the enhancement. Confirm the list source on the live tool.

providers_list_reports.r01.s05.c01.notes: Lookup-fed dropdown captured collapsed (only ALL known). Options from lookup:definitions:state (50 states + DC). Filters rpt_provider_dim.state (provider letterhead address state, free text) normalised to the USPS code through rpt_value_map domain state (03 3.7). Which provider state the legacy filter reads (address state assumed, not licence state) is INFERRED. ALL keeps providers without a state. Legacy is single-select; a list is the enhancement.

providers_list_reports.r02.s04.c01.notes: Primary date range, start. Legacy header LAST VISIT DATE RANGE is a re-used string from Patient List - Grouped By (vendor-doc correction); the range is the holiday date (date_basis = holiday_date, fixed, 04 7.2). Row test (INFERRED, the document's reading): a one-time holiday whose holiday_date lies in the range; a recurring holiday (is_recurring) contributes its occurrences that fall in the range. Default = today in the office time zone (relative token); enhanced with presets.

providers_list_reports.r02.s04.c02.notes: Primary date range, inclusive end; date_basis = holiday_date (legacy header is a re-used mislabel). Same intersection rule as the start date (INFERRED). Default = today in the office time zone; enhanced with presets and relative tokens.
